name: Obsidian Kanban MCP
description: Task board kept as Markdown files in an Obsidian vault: list boards and cards, add and move cards, add to descriptions, comment and set follow-ups through the local board server. Rewriting a whole description is the one tool that removes text and is gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start with kanban_list_boards and kanban_list_cards; they only read the board.
kanban_update_card adds a paragraph and links without removing description text; prefer it to kanban_replace_description, which rewrites the whole description.
The MCP server writes no files itself: it calls the board server's HTTP API, the only writer of the vault's Markdown. Deleting cards or boards is not offered to agents.
The board server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Set KANBAN_API_TOKEN only when the board runs with API_TOKEN.
This entry matches the obsidian-kanban-mcp executable. Launched as node <path>/dist/server.js, the server keeps Guard's normal handling; set it up on Guard's Protect page.
